description:
Land Acquisition - Melpitiya, NAula D/S/D, Matale District 
Muruthenge, Kuliyapitiya East D/S/D, Kurunegala District
Amendment, Gazette No 2342/21 of 25.07.2023
reasoning: The gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific land acquisition orders, detailed descriptions of land parcels (including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and survey plans), and a correction to a previous land acquisition notice. While a government minister is named as the issuing authority, the core subject matter is land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification for land and property-related matters. The mention of the minister is incidental to the execution of the land acquisition process and does not shift the focus to government personnel or portfolio responsibilities.
